headword.status_note: 按请求保留 official 标签；本词为英语文学造词，此标签不代表 DBP 对其马来语规范词地位的认证。音标按英语构词读音给出。

morphology.formula: ∅ + mockingjay → mockingjay；英语内部为 mockingbird 与 jabberjay 的混成
morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中作为英语文学名称整词使用，不按马来语词缀拆分；英语复数为 mockingjays，词尾读 /z/。

senses.zh_definition: 嘲笑鸟：苏珊·柯林斯《饥饿游戏》系列中的虚构鸟类，由雄性 jabberjay 与雌性 mockingbird 繁衍而来，能模仿鸟鸣和人类旋律；其形象也成为反抗的象征。
senses.en_definition: A fictional bird in Suzanne Collins's Hunger Games series, descended from jabberjays and mockingbirds and able to imitate birdsong and human melodies; also a symbol of resistance.
senses.ms_definition: Burung rekaan dalam siri The Hunger Games karya Suzanne Collins, hasil pembiakan jabberjay dengan mockingbird, yang dapat meniru kicauan burung dan melodi manusia serta menjadi lambang penentangan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语虚构物种名称，不是真实鸟类的马来语学名，也不能直接等同于 mockingbird（嘲鸫）。马来语释义为解释性译写。物种名通常小写，角色称号或作品标题可写作 Mockingjay。[原著节选](https://www.cosa.k12.or.us/sites/default/files/materials/events/6-5_bioethics_in_hunger_games.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 《嘲笑鸟》：苏珊·柯林斯于2010年出版的《饥饿游戏》三部曲第三部小说的英文标题，也用于相关电影改编的片名。
senses.en_definition: The title of the third novel in Suzanne Collins's original Hunger Games trilogy, published in 2010, and used in the titles of its film adaptations.
senses.ms_definition: Judul novel ketiga dalam trilogi asal The Hunger Games karya Suzanne Collins, yang diterbitkan pada tahun 2010, serta judul yang digunakan dalam adaptasi filemnya.
senses.nuances: 作品名首字母写作大写 Mockingjay；谈电影时宜注明完整片名或具体部分，避免与小说混淆。[Scholastic 出版公告](https://www.scholastic.com/newsroom/all-news/press-release/scholastic-increases-first-printing-of-mockingjay--the-final-boo.html)

dual_scenarios.context: 文学评论 / 文化报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam siri The Hunger Games, burung mockingjay menjadi lambang penentangan terhadap pemerintahan Capitol.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在《饥饿游戏》系列中，嘲笑鸟成为反抗都城统治的象征。
dual_scenarios.en: In The Hunger Games series, the mockingjay becomes a symbol of resistance to the Capitol's rule.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lencana mockingjay itu cantik. Di manakah awak membelinya?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个嘲笑鸟徽章真好看，在哪儿买的？
dual_scenarios.en: That mockingjay pin looks great. Where did you get it?

etymology.historical_story: Suzanne Collins created the mockingjay for the fictional world of The Hunger Games. Its name blends mockingbird with jabberjay, reflecting its imagined parentage. A creature descended from the Capitol's abandoned surveillance birds becomes an emblem of resistance. The name later supplied the title of the trilogy's third novel, published in 2010. [原著节选](https://www.cosa.k12.or.us/sites/default/files/materials/events/6-5_bioethics_in_hunger_games.pdf)；[出版公告](https://www.scholastic.com/newsroom/all-news/press-release/scholastic-increases-first-printing-of-mockingjay--the-final-boo.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mockingbird 的 mocking 加上 jabberjay 的 jay：名字本身就像故事里的混种鸟。
